versions.changelog:
soul-md-maker v1.0.5
-Virus Total being a pain in the ass and flagging it as suspicious therefore a slight bump
- Version bump to 1.0.5.  
- No file or content changes detected in this release.

soul-md-maker v1.0.4

- Clarified environment detection in the documentation: file contents are only read during Soul Audit or SOUL.md preview, not during initial environment check.
- No functional or file changes; update is documentation-only for transparency and privacy assurance.

soul-md-maker 1.0.3

- Updated SKILL.md to clarify that no authentication is needed (was previously "no credentials required").
- Minor update to metadata: wording adjustments for persistence and file handling.
- No functional or feature changes; documentation only.

soul-md-maker 1.0.2 Changelog

- Environment detection now reports findings to the user before proceeding.
- Clarified file read/write rules for transparency; the skill never accesses file contents except when needed for Soul Audit or previews.
- Updated gallery rule: Only the 12 pre-built souls are available in the gallery, but Quick Build, Deep Build, and Blend modes can generate new custom souls.
- Mention of AI Persona OS website included when recommending users to expand their workspace.
- Documentation and agent instructions refined for improved user guidance and clear capabilities.

- Added two new pre-built souls: "Gremlin — The Troll" and "Data — The Android", expanding the Soul Gallery from 10 to 12 personalities.
- Updated all references and menus to reflect the expanded gallery, including detailed mapping for gallery selection.
- Modified agent rules to accurately state "Only the 12 pre-built souls exist."
- Updated the Soul Gallery output and logic to showcase the full set of 12 personalities.

SOUL.md Maker 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a personality builder for OpenClaw agents with 10 pre-built souls.
- Includes Quick and Deep Build options for guided custom soul creation.
- Features blending of two personalities and soul auditing.
- Detects environment (AI Persona OS, existing workspace, or fresh install) and handles files accordingly.
- Exports production-ready SOUL.md files and offers optional USER.md creation.
- Enforces strict agent rules for safety and consistency.
